system.description:
At 20th level, the hedge witch’s @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.JvJFJD75EUKg00TE]{Potioncraft} reaches its pinnacle. They may now prepare two potions per short rest and gain access to two additional potion types.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.equipment.Item.Tft7ANrI8KXF7e09]{Death}. A creature that willingly drinks this potion, aware of its effects, dies with no saving throws. A creature unaware of the potion’s nature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, they instead take 6d10 necrotic damage. If this damage would reduce them to 0 HP they become doomed.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.equipment.Item.WJEVQi8VF84dDMFT]{Life}. When poured into the mouth of a creature who died within the last 50 years, this potion restores the target to life with a number of hit points equal to its character level or challenge rating. This does not restore any missing limbs, and if the creature lacks one or more vital organs they become doomed.
